0022600217.text: The Washington Wizards (3-7, 2-5 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) are 10th in the East and 3 games back in the Southeast, while the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, on a two-game losing streak) are 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with T.J. McConnell listed as day-to-day with a hamstring issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on 2026-02-20.
